label: sdc01_0390_ogre_01
text: Pon-yo-pon!

label: sdc01_0390_sister_01
text: We’re back, Ogerpon![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0390_sister_02
text: All right! Let’s combine the info we’ve gathered![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0390_sister_03
text: You go first, Kiki![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0390_brother_02
text: OK, well, here’s what I heard...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0390_sister_04
text: Hmm, I see. Interesting...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0390_sister_05
text: Thanks to the information you two brought,\nI think we know exactly where each of those\r\nLousy Three is hiding![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0390_select_01
text: That’s great news!

label: sdc01_0390_select_02
text: What’d you learn, Carmine?

label: sdc01_0390_sister_06
text: I knew the Mask Retrieval Squad I assembled\nwouldn’t let me down![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0390_sister_16
text: Rest assured, your fearless leader—that’s\nme—sees your hard work and effort![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0390_sister_07
text: Look, I’m the leader here. Mundane work like\ngathering info just doesn’t suit me.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0390_sister_17
text: Besides, I tried talking to a few people here and\nthere, but they got all nervous and stuff!\c\nI’m just too pretty for my own good.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0390_sister_08
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I’ll record everything we found out about those
three to your Rotom Phone,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)].
That way
we
won’t
forget
any
of it![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0390_sister_09
text: Now then, let’s go retrieve those masks![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0390_sister_10
text: We can do this![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0390_brother_03
text: I’m...I’m not goin’.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0390_sister_11
text: What? You’re part of the team! You need to\ncome along![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0390_brother_04
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]As long as [VAR 0x0100(0000)]’s around,
I’m
sure
Ogerpon
will
feel
safe...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0390_brother_05
text: ’Sides, I got things to do...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0390_sister_12
text: Huh. I wonder if he’s still upset?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0390_sister_13
text: Oh well! I can’t force him to tag along. Let’s just\ntake care of this ourselves![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0390_sister_14
text: You can decide where we head first![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0390_sister_15
text: Let’s get all of Ogerpon’s masks back, all right?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0390_ogre_02
text: Pon-yo-pon!
